interpretations.statement: Unreviewed interpretation: Within the stated assessment domain, prior consultation is required if the product is new, has tokenisation features and plans to seek SFC authorisation, or if the proposal tokenises an existing SFC-authorised product, or if it materially changes the tokenisation arrangements of an existing tokenised SFC-authorised product.

assumptions: For the material-change branch, the assessment domain is restricted to arrangements of tokenised SFC-authorised investment products. This is a domain assumption, not an added meaning or assigned truth value for materialchange.
The output concerns only the consultation requirement under the selected sentences in the retained edition.
Material-change classification is supplied and is not inferred by the formalization.

citations.quote: For new investment products that have tokenisation features and plan to seek the SFC’s authorisation, prior consultation with the SFC is required.

Prior consultation is also required for tokenisation of existing SFC-authorised investment products and/or material changes to the tokenisation arrangements of tokenised SFC-authorised investment products.
Such change(s) may require prior approval8.

reading.distinction: The new-product branch requires both tokenisation features and planned authorisation. The existing-product tokenisation and material-change branches independently trigger consultation: “and/or” includes either and both. Possible approval creates no additional consultation condition. The source does not support a materially competing trigger formula; the strongest uncertainty is the authorisation qualification missing from the materialchange input.
